list.label: Matched route

panels.title: Request duration histogram
panels.description: Estimated request counts across all HTTP statuses. Each upper bound is inclusive. The final bar includes every request slower than 500 ms.

targets.expr:
label_replace(
  sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="personal/kochwiki", deployment_environment_name="$environment", deployment_environment_name!="", http_route=~`${route:regex}`, le="0.05"}[$__range])),
  "bucket", "1", "", ""
) or label_replace(
  sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="personal/kochwiki", deployment_environment_name="$environment", deployment_environment_name!="", http_route=~`${route:regex}`, le="0.2"}[$__range]))
  - sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="personal/kochwiki", deployment_environment_name="$environment", deployment_environment_name!="", http_route=~`${route:regex}`, le="0.05"}[$__range])),
  "bucket", "2", "", ""
) or label_replace(
  sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="personal/kochwiki", deployment_environment_name="$environment", deployment_environment_name!="", http_route=~`${route:regex}`, le="0.5"}[$__range]))
  - sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="personal/kochwiki", deployment_environment_name="$environment", deployment_environment_name!="", http_route=~`${route:regex}`, le="0.2"}[$__range])),
  "bucket", "3", "", ""
) or label_replace(
  sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="personal/kochwiki", deployment_environment_name="$environment", deployment_environment_name!="", http_route=~`${route:regex}`, le="+Inf"}[$__range]))
  - sum(increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="personal/kochwiki", deployment_environment_name="$environment", deployment_environment_name!="", http_route=~`${route:regex}`, le="0.5"}[$__range])),
  "bucket", "4", "", ""
)
